query: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN r.verified=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) FROM reviews r JOIN products p USING(category,ref_id) WHERE p.category='office products' AND p.status='archived' AND r.verification_label IS NULL
columns: ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN r.verified=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1)
